verdict.rationale: LightSprint is an agent platform, so running its agent headlessly from CI/CD or shell scripts is a fair question. The evidence shows only background cloud agents launched from its board, plus GitHub Actions running as standard PR checks. Neither is a documented CLI, API or headless mode that a pipeline or script could invoke, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts
